# Fox News

> Fox News publishes breaking news, live coverage, video, and topic pages across U.S., politics, world, business, health, entertainment, and sports.

Fox News is a digital news network centered on fast-moving headlines, article archives, video, opinion, and topic hubs. Its broader ecosystem includes Fox Business, Fox Weather, Fox News Audio, Fox Nation, Fox Noticias, and related verticals for specialized coverage.

## Main News
- [Fox News Home](https://www.foxnews.com/): Homepage for breaking news, top stories, featured video, and major coverage areas.
- [U.S.](https://www.foxnews.com/us): National news coverage including crime, immigration, education, and public safety.
- [Politics](https://www.foxnews.com/politics): Political news, campaigns, Congress, White House, and policy developments.
- [World](https://www.foxnews.com/world): International news, conflicts, diplomacy, and global developments.
- [Opinion](https://www.foxnews.com/opinion): Commentary, analysis, editorials, and contributor perspectives on current events.
- [Media](https://www.foxnews.com/media): News about journalism, television, digital media, and cultural controversies.
- [Video](https://www.foxnews.com/video): News clips, interviews, show segments, and breaking video coverage.

## U.S. Coverage
- [U.S.](https://www.foxnews.com/us): Main U.S. news section with national headlines and regional stories.
- [Blue City Crime](https://www.foxnews.com/category/us/blue-city-crime): Coverage focused on crime and public safety in major cities.
- [Campus Radicals](https://www.foxnews.com/category/us/campus-radicals): Reporting on higher education controversies, protests, and campus politics.
- [Border Crisis](https://www.foxnews.com/category/us/immigration): Immigration and border security news, policy, and enforcement coverage.
- [True Crime](https://www.foxnews.com/true-crime): Crime reporting, investigations, court cases, and criminal justice stories.

## Politics & Government
- [Politics](https://www.foxnews.com/politics): Central politics hub for elections, government, and legislative coverage.
- [Donald Trump](https://www.foxnews.com/category/person/donald-trump): Topic page aggregating coverage related to Donald Trump.
- [Senate](https://www.foxnews.com/category/politics/senate): News and analysis on the U.S. Senate and legislation.
- [House](https://www.foxnews.com/category/politics/house-of-representatives): Coverage of the House of Representatives, leadership, and votes.
- [Judiciary](https://www.foxnews.com/category/politics/judiciary): Reporting on courts, legal disputes, and judicial nominations.
- [Foreign Policy](https://www.foxnews.com/category/politics/foreign-policy): U.S. foreign policy, diplomacy, and national security developments.
- [Fox News Polls](https://www.foxnews.com/official-polls): Official polling results, survey data, and voter sentiment snapshots.

## Business & Economy
- [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/): Business news site covering markets, economy, companies, and personal finance.
- [Markets](https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets): Stock market news, indexes, commodities, and trading updates.
- [Economy](https://www.foxbusiness.com/economy): Economic indicators, inflation, jobs, and macroeconomic reporting.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.foxbusiness.com/personal-finance): Consumer finance guidance, taxes, retirement, and household money topics.
- [Technology](https://www.foxbusiness.com/category/technology): Business-focused technology coverage, companies, and innovation news.

## Lifestyle & Culture
- [Entertainment](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment): Celebrity news, television, movies, music, and pop culture coverage.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.foxnews.com/lifestyle): Travel, food, real estate, style, and everyday living features.
- [Health](https://www.foxnews.com/health): Health news, wellness reporting, medical studies, and public health updates.
- [Food & Drink](https://www.foxnews.com/food-drink): Recipes, restaurant news, nutrition, and food culture stories.
- [Travel](https://www.foxnews.com/travel): Travel news, destination features, airline updates, and trip advice.

## Sports & Weather
- [Sports](https://www.foxnews.com/sports): Sports headlines, leagues, athletes, and major event coverage.
- [Fox Weather](https://www.foxweather.com/): Dedicated weather platform with forecasts, alerts, and storm coverage.
- [Weather News](https://www.foxweather.com/weather-news): Weather reporting on severe storms, climate events, and forecasts.
- [Radar](https://www.foxweather.com/radar): Interactive radar and map-based weather tracking tools.

## Video, Audio & Streaming
- [Video](https://www.foxnews.com/video): On-demand news video, interviews, and clips from Fox programming.
- [Fox News Audio](https://radio.foxnews.com/): Radio, podcasts, and streaming audio from Fox News personalities and shows.
- [Podcasts](https://radio.foxnews.com/podcast/): Podcast directory for news, politics, and talk programming.
- [Fox Nation](https://nation.foxnews.com/): Subscription streaming service with exclusive shows, documentaries, and specials.
- [LiveNOW from FOX](https://www.foxnews.com/livenow): Live news video stream featuring breaking events and press conferences.

## Special Products & Services
- [Books](https://www.foxnews.com/books): Fox News Books storefront featuring titles from Fox personalities and contributors.
- [Fox News Polls](https://www.foxnews.com/official-polls): Polling product with survey releases and historical poll coverage.
- [Newsletters](https://www.foxnews.com/newsletters): Email newsletter signup hub for major Fox News topics and shows.
- [Apps & Products](https://www.foxnews.com/apps-products): Information about Fox News mobile apps and connected device access.

## Spanish-Language & Related Brands
- [Fox Noticias](https://noticias.foxnews.com/): Spanish-language Fox News site with translated and original news coverage.
- [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/): Sister site focused on business, markets, and economic reporting.
- [Fox Weather](https://www.foxweather.com/): Weather-focused brand for forecasts, alerts, and storm tracking.
- [Fox News Audio](https://radio.foxnews.com/): Audio network for radio shows, podcasts, and live listening.
- [Fox Nation](https://nation.foxnews.com/): Streaming platform for exclusive long-form and personality-driven content.
- [OutKick](https://www.outkick.com/): Related sports and culture site with commentary and news coverage.
